teaser.en: The Digo call it 'forest sisal', and a Digo proverb reminds us that one cut rope does not mean the sisal is finished.
teaser.sw: Wadigo huiita 'mkonge wa msituni', na methali ya Kidigo inatukumbusha kwamba kamba moja ikikatika haimaanishi mkonge umekwisha.
teaser.dg: Adigo anachiiha 'konje ra tsakani', na ndarira ya Chidigo inahutambukiza kukala lugbwe mwenga uchidoswa, makonje tagamala.

summary.en: *Chongwa* is a wild bowstring hemp with stiff, sword-like leaves full of fibre. It is the forest's own sisal.
summary.sw: *Chongwa* ni mmea wa porini wa aina ya *bowstring hemp* wenye majani magumu kama upanga yaliyojaa nyuzi. Ni mkonge wa msitu wenyewe.
summary.dg: *Chongwa* ni mmea wa weruni wa jamii ya *bowstring hemp*, wenye makodza mafu ga dza upanga, ganayodzala katani. Ni konje ra tsakani.

about.en:
*Chongwa* grows as a cluster of stiff, thick, sword-shaped leaves rising straight from a creeping underground stem. The leaves are tough and fibrous, often mottled or banded in shades of green, and look much like those of sisal.

It spreads slowly by its rhizomes into small colonies. Its flowers, when they appear, are pale and grow on an upright spike.
about.sw:
*Chongwa* hukua kama kichaka cha majani magumu, manene, yenye umbo la upanga yanayochipuka moja kwa moja kutoka shina linalotambaa chini ya ardhi. Majani ni magumu na yana nyuzi, mara nyingi yakiwa na madoa au mistari ya rangi mbalimbali za kijani, na yanafanana sana na ya mkonge.

Huenea polepole kwa viazi (mashina ya chini ya ardhi) na kufanya makundi madogo. Maua yake, yanapotokea, ni ya rangi hafifu na hukua juu ya shada lililosimama wima.
about.dg:
*Chongwa* chinamera dza bunda ra makodza mafu na maziho ga dza upanga, ganayoima chocho kula kpwa muhi unaoambala tsini. Makodza ni mafu na gana katani nyinji, mara nyinji gana vibara au misitari ya chijani ya rangi tafwauti, na ganahalana sana na makodza ga konje.

Chinaenea pore-pore kpwa mizi ya tsini na kuhenda mabunda madide. Maruwage, ganaphotuluka, ni ga rangi ya ngushu-ngushu na ganamera kpwenye mlita uimao chocho.

where.en: *Chongwa* grows on the forest floor and in dry bush, often in shaded patches under trees.
where.sw: *Chongwa* hukua sakafuni mwa msitu na katika vichaka vikavu, mara nyingi katika sehemu zenye kivuli chini ya miti.
where.dg: *Chongwa* chinamera photsi tsakani na weruni kukavu, mara nyinji phatu pha pepho photsi ya mihi.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded. The leaves of bowstring hemps are full of strong fibre, and in many parts of Africa they have been used for cord, rope and bowstrings, which is where the English name comes from.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa. Majani ya mimea ya aina ya *bowstring hemp* yamejaa nyuzi imara, na katika sehemu nyingi za Afrika yametumika kutengeneza uzi, kamba na kamba za pinde, na ndiko jina lake la Kiingereza linakotoka.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa kpwa mmea hinyu. Makodza ga mimea ya *bowstring hemp* gana katani ngumu nyinji, na kpwenye seemu nyinji za Afrika gakahumirwa kuhenda lugbwe, kamba na lugbwe za uha; ndiko riphotuluka dzina ra Chingereza.

culture.en: Its Digo name *konje tsaka* means 'forest sisal'. *Konje* is the ordinary word for the sisal plant, and it appears in a Digo proverb: *Chiphala kudosa lugbwe siko kumala makonje*, 'If an antelope cuts a rope, it does not mean the sisal is finished.' A single loss does not exhaust the source.
culture.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo *konje tsaka* linamaanisha 'mkonge wa msituni'. *Konje* ni neno la kawaida la mmea wa mkonge, na linatokea katika methali ya Kidigo: *Chiphala kudosa lugbwe siko kumala makonje*, 'Swala akikata kamba, haimaanishi mkonge umekwisha.' Hasara moja haimalizi chanzo.
culture.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo *konje tsaka* manage ni 'konje ra tsakani'. *Konje* ni dzina ra kawaida ra mmea wa konge, na rinatuluka kpwenye ndarira ya Chidigo: *Chiphala kudosa lugbwe siko kumala makonje*, 'Chiphala chichidosa lugbwe, taimaanisha makonje gakamala.' Hasara mwenga taimaanisha kukala phatu chitu chinaphophahikana phakamala.

names.en: Digo: *chongwa*, also *konje tsaka*, 'forest sisal'. English: bowstring hemp. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Sansevieria kirkii* (now often placed in *Dracaena*).
names.sw: Kidigo: *chongwa*, pia *konje tsaka*, 'mkonge wa msituni'. Kwa Kiingereza: *bowstring hemp*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huiita *Sansevieria kirkii* (siku hizi mara nyingi huwekwa katika *Dracaena*).
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *chongwa*, piya *konje tsaka*, 'konje ra tsakani'. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *bowstring hemp*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Sansevieria kirkii* (sambi kahi-kahi chinaikpwa kpwenye *Dracaena*).

reason.en: Wild asparagus, in the same plant family
reason.sw: Asparagasi wa porini, katika familia moja ya mimea
Mmea mwingine wenye majani manene wa vichaka vikavu
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wenye makodza ga nyama wa weruni kukavu

reason.en: Screw pine, another leaf used for fibre and weaving
reason.sw: Mkadi, jani jingine linalotumika kwa nyuzi na usukaji
reason.dg: *Mkadi*, kodza ranjina rinarohumirwa kpwa katani na kusuka
